page_label: 说　明　书　3/17 页

paragraphs.notes: Marker carries no prose. It labels the reaction scheme drawing that occupies this paragraph slot (drawing 1).

paragraphs.zh: 式中M表示碱金属，R表示2,2,2-三氟乙基或2-四氢呋喃甲基。
paragraphs.en: In the formula, M represents an alkali metal, and R represents 2,2,2-trifluoroethyl or 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl.
paragraphs.notes: This is the legend for the scheme in [0021]. 2-四氢呋喃甲基 is translated literally as 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl; the printed name does not state the ring oxygen numbering explicitly.

paragraphs.zh: 所述方法在酯解环节中在碱作用下使原料的酯键断裂，将甲氧基从分子中移出，进而得到了2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐，该盐进一步与相应的醇或醇钠发生缩合反应制备得到目标化合物。此法在醚化之前将甲氧基移出，有效避免了后续醚化反应中杂质2-氯-3-甲氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的产生，目标化合物收率和品质得到了大幅的提升。
paragraphs.en: In the said method, in the ester-cleavage step the ester bond of the raw material is broken under the action of a base, removing the methoxy group from the molecule, and thereby 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is obtained; this salt further undergoes a condensation reaction with the corresponding alcohol or sodium alkoxide to prepare the target compound. This method removes the methoxy group before etherification, effectively avoiding the formation of the impurity 2-chloro-3-methoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid in the subsequent etherification reaction, and the yield and quality of the target compound are greatly improved.
paragraphs.notes: 醇钠 translated literally as sodium alkoxide; the drawing in [0021] writes the more general ROM (M = alkali metal).

paragraphs.zh: 酯的碱解为常规反应，但本发明中所用的原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的分子结构中存在对碱较为敏感的活性基团苄溴，常规的酯的水解手段在本发明中不可行，苄溴基团会参与反应生成大量的苄醇以及二苄醚类化合物，结构式如下：
paragraphs.en: Alkaline cleavage of esters is a conventional reaction, but in the molecular structure of the raw material used in this invention, methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, there is the benzyl bromide group, an active group that is rather sensitive to base; conventional means of ester hydrolysis are not feasible in this invention, because the benzyl bromide group would take part in the reaction and generate large amounts of benzyl alcohol and dibenzyl ether type compounds, whose structural formula is as follows:
paragraphs.notes: 苄溴 is translated as benzyl bromide, meaning the benzylic bromomethyl group here rather than the free compound PhCH2Br.
Marker carries no prose. It labels the single structure drawing announced by [0024] (drawing 2).

paragraphs.zh: 本发明在特殊溶剂体系即三级醇溶剂中进行此反应，能很好的降低苄溴的活性，碱解环节产物纯度较高。
paragraphs.en: This invention carries out this reaction in a special solvent system, namely a tertiary alcohol solvent, which can very well reduce the reactivity of the benzyl bromide, and the purity of the product of the alkaline-cleavage step is relatively high.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(1)中所述三级醇为叔丁醇、叔戊醇或2-甲基-2-戊醇中的任意一种或至少两种的组合，优选为叔丁醇。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of this invention, the tertiary alcohol in step (1) is any one of tert-butanol, tert-amyl alcohol or 2-methyl-2-pentanol, or a combination of at least two of them, preferably tert-butanol.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(1)中相对于1mol的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯，所述三级醇溶剂的用量为700～3500mL，例如可以是700mL、1000mL、1500mL，2000mL、2500mL、3000mL或3500mL。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (1), relative to 1 mol of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, the amount of the said tertiary alcohol solvent is 700-3500 mL, for example it may be 700 mL, 1000 mL, 1500 mL, 2000 mL, 2500 mL, 3000 mL or 3500 mL.
paragraphs.notes: As printed, the separator after 1500mL is a full-width comma （，） where every other item in the list uses the enumeration comma （、）. Preserved verbatim, not normalised.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(1)中所述原料与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1～1.1)，例如可以是1:1、1:1.02、1:1.05、1:1.08或1:1.1。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of this invention, in step (1) the molar ratio of the said raw material to the basic substance is 1:(1-1.1), for example it may be 1:1, 1:1.02, 1:1.05, 1:1.08 or 1:1.1.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(1)中所述碱性物质为氢氧化钠、氢氧化钾、叔丁醇钠、叔丁醇钾、氢化钠、氢化钾、金属钠或金属钾中的任意一种，优选为氢氧化钠。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the basic substance in step (1) is any one of sodium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide, sodium tert-butoxide, potassium tert-butoxide, sodium hydride, potassium hydride, sodium metal or potassium metal, preferably sodium hydroxide.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钠使用时先制成氢氧化钠水溶液，氢氧化钠的质量浓度为30～96％，例如可以是30％、40％、50％、60％、70％、85％或96％。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the said sodium hydroxide is first made into an aqueous sodium hydroxide solution when used, and the mass concentration of the sodium hydroxide is 30-96%, for example it may be 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 85% or 96%.
paragraphs.notes: A 96％ by mass aqueous hydroxide solution is chemically odd but is what is printed. Not corrected.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述氢氧化钾使用时先制成氢氧化钠水溶液，氢氧化钾的质量浓度为30～96％，例如可以是30％、40％、50％、60％、70％、85％或96％。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the said potassium hydroxide is first made into an aqueous sodium hydroxide solution when used, and the mass concentration of the potassium hydroxide is 30-96%, for example it may be 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 85% or 96%.
paragraphs.notes: As printed, this paragraph says potassium hydroxide is made into an aqueous SODIUM hydroxide solution （氢氧化钠水溶液）, which appears to be a copy of [0031] that was not fully edited. Transcribed and translated literally; not corrected. Confirmed character-for-character against the text layer.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(1)中所述酯解反应的温度为25～40℃，例如可以是25℃、30℃、35℃或40℃。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of this invention, the temperature of the ester-cleavage reaction in step (1) is 25-40 degrees C, for example it may be 25, 30, 35 or 40 degrees C.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(1)中所述酯解反应的时间为5～12h，例如可以是5h、8h、10h或12h。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the time of the ester-cleavage reaction in step (1) is 5-12 h, for example it may be 5 h, 8 h, 10 h or 12 h.

paragraphs.zh: 作为本发明优选的技术方案，步骤(2)中所述醇为2,2,2-三氟乙醇或2-四氢呋喃甲醇。
paragraphs.en: As a preferred technical solution of this invention, the alcohol in step (2) is 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol or 2-tetrahydrofurylmethanol.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与与醇的摩尔比为1:
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (2) the molar ratio of 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt to to the alcohol is 1:

substituents: C(=O)OM (carboxylate of an alkali metal M) at C1
structures.name: alkali metal 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate

drawings.notes: Generic (Markush) scheme for step (2) of the invention, the etherification of the benzylic bromide with simultaneous acidification of the carboxylate. Both drawn structures carry variable groups: M is written as a letter on the carboxylate oxygen of the left structure and R as a letter on the ether oxygen of the right structure, defined in [0022] as an alkali metal and as 2,2,2-trifluoroethyl or 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl respectively. SMILES is null for both structures for that reason: the drawing does not determine every atom. Substituent positions were read off the drawing: on the left structure the four substituted vertices are consecutive, reading COOM, then Cl, then CH2Br, then SO2CH3 around the ring, with the two remaining vertices unsubstituted. Reagent text above the arrow reads ROH followed by the enumeration comma and 碱 (base); below the arrow, 或ROM (or ROM). Above and below are recorded separately as printed and are not merged. Both lines are legible.

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st, single structure spanning the drawing; described here as two benzene rings joined by a CH2-O-CH2 bridge
structures.core: two benzene rings joined by an oxybis(methylene) bridge (a dibenzyl ether)
structures.name: 3,3'-(oxybis(methylene))bis(2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid)

drawings.notes: A single symmetric structure, not a scheme: no arrow is drawn. It is the dibenzyl ether by-product that [0024] says conventional ester hydrolysis of the raw material would generate, so it is a by-product of the rejected conventional approach rather than a step of the invention's route or a cited prior art route; presented_as is set to intermediate_structure as the closest available value for a standalone drawn structure and this note carries the real role. The left ring is drawn rotated relative to the right ring, but both carry the same four substituents on four consecutive ring vertices in the same order (COOH, Cl, CH2, SO2CH3), which was checked vertex by vertex on both rings, so the molecule is symmetric about the bridging oxygen. The SMILES was written from the drawn connectivity only.
